value.rationale: The exact pairwise merging time is a central, motivated local synchronization invariant. The theorem gives a natural complete classification in all orders, proves no two pairs have equal optimum lengths, and identifies a single Hamiltonian optimal-control path whose suffixes uniquely serve every pair; these structural facts go substantially beyond the already-known worst-case bound.
